comments: Submitted by the vendor (A2Z Tools). The PDF is checked in the browser and is not uploaded. A companion tool, the A2Z Accessibility Contrast Matrix, was submitted separately.
features: Browser-based PDF accessibility checker: open a PDF (up to 100 MB) and check the machine-verifiable basics - tagged structure, document language and title, image alternate text, table headers, bookmarks and extractable text - with evidence for each result and a list of the manual checks that remain. Free, no sign-up.
title: A2Z PDF Accessibility Checker
